row: ECPI University is built for career-focused individuals seeking focused education and real outcomes. Since 1966, ECPI University has delivered hands-on programs in Technology, Nursing, Health Science, Business, and more, with accelerated pathways that allow students to earn a bachelor’s degree in as little as 2.5 years. With experienced faculty and a commitment to student success, ECPI University provides a learning environment centered on momentum, opportunity, and measurable results.
